negative_snippets:
⭐☆☆☆☆

I had one of the worst experiences staying at Hotel Rampal Palace. The condition of the property is far below acceptable standards.

Room & Cleanliness:
The room allotted was in a very bad state. The bedsheets were dirty, torn, and clearly not changed for new guests. All the linen looked unhygienic, and the towels provided were old, rough, and in extremely poor condition. The room also had a strong foul smell, and despite raising the issue with reception, no proper solution was given. They just sent a housekeeping boy with a fragrance spray, which only masked the odor for a few minutes instead of fixing the root problem.

Hygiene & Maintenance:
The hotel shows no sense of cleanliness or hygiene. Dust and dirt were visible in corners, the washroom was not properly cleaned, and basic maintenance seemed completely ignored. Even outside the hotel, the surroundings were dirty and unkempt, creating a very unpleasant atmosphere before even stepping inside.

Staff Behavior:
The reception staff was unhelpful and unfriendly. Rather than showing concern for guest comfort, they almost ignored my complaints. The attitude towards guests felt careless and unprofessional, which made the overall stay even worse.

Location & Clientele:
Most of the hotel’s clientele is linked to Apollo Hospital, which makes hygiene and cleanliness even more important. Patients and their families often stay here, and one would expect the property to maintain the highest standards of hygiene. Unfortunately, that is not the case. The lack of proper care and cleanliness is shocking, especially considering the type of guests who rely on this hotel.

Overall Experience:
This hotel fails to meet even the most basic standards of hospitality. Poor hygiene, lack of proper maintenance, unclean surroundings, and rude staff make it a place I would never recommend. Guests deserve respect, cleanliness, and comfort—unfortunately, Hotel Rampal Palace provides none of these. Very bad experience overall.
